context: Naoko buys Hina-young a small accessory as a gift; mock-grumpy generosity.
purpose: Aunt giving teen gift with playful gruffness.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Hina — here, one more for you.
lines.style: Warm Kansai drawl, gruff-soft at the edges. Casual generosity — the kind that doesn't make a show of itself. A slight lean-in, like she's conspiring with Hina against the rest of the world.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright awed surprise, hesitant. Voice lifts slightly on the question. Genuine delight with a touch of disbelief — is this really happening? Small, warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Yeah — I thought you were cute.
lines.style: Soft, almost shy underneath the gruffness. Kansai lilt steady. A small laugh threaded through — admitting something tender without making it awkward. Looking away slightly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, genuine warmth. Words tumble out with uncomplicated joy. No performance — just real delight. Open and unselfconscious, the way children are when they mean it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Heh — it's just a little something from me.
lines.style: Soft Kansai warmth, humble and pleased. A small laugh. Deflecting the gratitude gently, like she's uncomfortable with being thanked for doing what feels natural. Genuine fondness underneath.
